  "created": "2024-04-04T08:15:00Z",
  "description": "During the Q1 2024 compliance audit, read-only access to the NovaTech GitHub organization revealed hardcoded credentials in the infrastructure repository:\n\n- File: infra/prod/terraform/modules/database/variables.tf\n  AWS secret access key: AKIA1337919158EXAMPLE\n\n- File: infra/staging/terraform/modules/jenkins/config.json\n  Plaintext Jenkins admin password: NovaTech$ecure2024!\n\nThese credentials were introduced in pull request #442 committed by Marcus Bell on April 3, 2024.\n\nExposure of these keys could allow full administrative access to NovaTech's production AWS RDS instances and Jenkins master node.\n\nRecommended remediation:\n1. Rotate the AWS secret access key and update any dependent services.\n2. Rotate the Jenkins admin password and update all configured agents.\n3. Redeploy the affected Terraform modules using AWS Secrets Manager for secret storage.\n4. Conduct a repository-wide scan for similar hardcoded secrets.\n\nPlease refer to the attached evidence PDF for screenshots.",
  "issue_key": "AUDIT-2024-0891",
  "priority": "Highest",
  "reporter": "aubri.nguyen@outlook.com",
  "status": "In Progress",
  "summary": "Audit evidence collection - hardcoded credentials",
  "updated": "2024-04-06T10:45:00Z"
}
